subject: Reliability depends on identifier quality, recording practices, preservation of sources, and safeguards against mistaken linkage.
rationale: S006 explicitly makes inferential strength dependent on reliable recording and safeguarding. S004 ties documentary continuity to identity and accounted-for handling. Identifier quality and linkage safeguards support correct attribution; recording practices and source preservation support the integrity and inspectability of histories. These mechanisms justify the qualitative dependency without establishing that existing records are reliable or defective. No quantified contribution or operational threshold is claimed.
